news.title: SC asks states to consider framing policy on demolition, regularisation of illegal constructions
news.para: The Supreme Court has called upon all states to develop a cohesive strategy regarding unauthorized constructions. This would encompass both the regularization and dismantling of enduring buildings across the country. The court refrained from issuing a unified policy due to differing conditions across states, instead urging local authorities to integrate the petition’s considerations into their new policies, expressing optimism for thoughtful implementation.

news.title: Delhi master plan 2047 estimates 40 lakh housing demand, banks on small-format, rental homes
news.para: Delhi's Master Plan proposes a three-pronged strategy to meet future housing needs. The plan emphasizes developing small-format affordable homes and rental housing options. It also promotes development in land pooling and transit-oriented zones. Existing housing areas will be regenerated and upgraded to improve living conditions. The strategy aims to curb unauthorized construction through disincentives and planned development.

news.title: BMC slaps ₹5.5 crore additional penalty on Taj Lands End over property tax dues; total fine ₹103 crore
news.para: Indian Hotels Company Ltd faces an additional penalty surpassing Rs 5.51 crore, further compounding existing charges related to property taxes on the Taj Lands End. Issued by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, these new claims have prompted the company to contest, asserting that there have been no violations. Consequently, the cumulative penalty now exceeds Rs 103 crore.

news.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate’s net loss widens 28% to ₹34.59 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Aditya Birla Real Estate's consolidated total income increased 30.7 per cent to ₹205.72 crore during the quarter. Its subsidiary Birla Estates has also entered the Navi Mumbai redevelopment market with a ₹2,600-crore project in Vashi.

news.title: Awfis Space Solutions’ net profit rises 140% to ₹23.96 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Awfis Space Solutions’ consolidated total income increased 27.1 per cent to ₹448.87 crore during the quarter. Its network expanded to 251 centres with approximately 1.70 lakh seats across 18 cities.

news.title: Brigade Enterprises’ net profit rises 37% to ₹216.94 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Brigade Enterprises’ consolidated total income declined 11.5 per cent to ₹1,179.22 crore during the quarter. It recorded sales of ₹1,061 crore, while average realisation increased 21 per cent year-on-year to ₹14,256 per sq. ft.

news.title: Kaara Hotels to invest ₹1,000 crore to add 120 properties in North India
news.para: Kaara Hotels plans to invest ₹1,000 crore over the next five years to expand across North India. The company aims to establish 120 properties in the region and create up to 15,000 direct and indirect jobs.

news.title: Curbs on land sale, purchase and transfer lifted in Pataliputra township
news.para: The Bihar government has lifted restrictions on land sales and transfers in Patna's Pataliputra Township, following the release of a draft development plan and official notifications. This significant change allows landowners the freedom to engage in real estate transactions throughout the township. Aiming to boost development while safeguarding stakeholder interests, this initiative brings much-needed certainty and relief to local residents and property owners alike.

news.title: EFC to acquire 100% stake in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions
news.para: EFC (I) has entered into a share acquisition agreement to acquire 100% stake in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions. The acquisition will strengthen EFC’s furniture manufacturing and design & build businesses.

news.title: Naksha survey outcome to await Bombay high court's verdict
news.para: The Bombay High Court is set to make a pivotal decision regarding the Naksha survey's outcome. In light of earlier notices being deemed incorrect, property document submission deadlines for Margao and Cuncolim have been extended. A new public notice aims to eliminate confusion regarding the survey, and the court has instructed the petitioner's advocate to provide written submissions.

news.title: Bihar government sanctions ₹628 crore for ongoing Patna metro project
news.para: Patna Metro has secured Rs 628.32 crore in central funding to accelerate its construction efforts. This crucial financial aid ensures that the urban transport project adheres to its timeline while enabling essential work. The state contributes 20% of the overall costs, with the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation overseeing operations for the priority corridor. This funding plays a vital role in maintaining momentum for Patna's mass transit initiative.

news.title: Haryana digitises prime khasra marking to tighten land records
news.para: Haryana has approved a digital Prime Khasra Module for standardized land plot identification. This technology-enabled workflow will bring consistency and transparency to the process. Authorized revenue officers can now verify records and upload documents online. A standard operating procedure and user manual will guide field implementation. This initiative aims to remove procedural variations and enhance accountability across the state.

news.title: Small homeowners in Lucknow to pay less for mutation
news.para: Homeowners with smaller properties can rejoice as the Lucknow Municipal Corporation has reduced mutation fees for property transfers through wills or inheritances. For homes measuring up to 1,000 square feet, the fee is now just one thousand rupees, while larger properties face higher rates, capped at five thousand rupees. This updated structure aims to make family-owned property transfers more accessible and straightforward.

news.title: About 180 properties in Gurugram served notices for flouting building code
news.para: Authorities in Gurugram are stepping up their efforts against illegal building practices and property misuse by issuing notices to violators. Following the Supreme Court's mandate, survey teams are meticulously inspecting licensed colonies. Those found in violation of regulations are at risk of facing serious actions, including possible sealing or demolition of illegal constructions. The initiative aims to guarantee compliance with established building plans and appropriate property usage.

news.title: Pilani Investment to sell 1.7 million UltraTech Cement shares for ₹1,908 crore
news.para: Pilani Investment plans to sell 1.7 million UltraTech Cement shares valued at ₹1,908 crore on August 13, 2026, at a 3% discount. Separately, UltraTech Cement is acquiring a 26% stake in Solaris Horizon Energy to support its green energy initiatives.

news.title: Two-storey dwelling units can now be redeveloped: Delhi development body
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority has sanctioned a policy focused on the overhaul of outdated two-storey residential units, with plans for broader application across the city. This will streamline building plan approvals by eliminating NOC requirements across multiple departments. Additionally, a crucial land use alteration for a metro depot in Narela Sub-City was approved, which aims to boost connectivity and promote regional growth.

news.title: PMAY falters in Mumbai as land prices, lack of bank credit leave 10,000-15,000 MHADA homes unallocated
news.para: The implementation of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana faces significant challenges in Mumbai due to high land costs and financing issues. Many eligible individuals are unable to obtain bank loans for homes valued between twelve and fifteen lakh rupees. Despite MHADA's construction of approximately fifty thousand residences, around ten to fifteen thousand units are yet to be allocated.

news.title: Ocean Seven’s licence cancelled in Gurugram, buyers seek another developer
news.para: Authorities in Gurugram have revoked the license of Ocean Seven Buildtech due to a stalled housing project, citing extensive delays and failure to meet construction milestones. Homebuyers expressed relief at the decision and are now searching for a new developer to finish the project. The government will assume control of the property, while investigations continue regarding potential fund misappropriation from buyers.

news.title: One in every three complaints lodged with Telangana RERA awaits resolution
news.para: Telangana RERA has a substantial backlog of unresolved complaints.  Nearly forty percent of lodged complaints remain pending resolution by the authority.  This contrasts with higher disposal rates seen in other major markets.  Telangana ranks high in project registrations but lags in complaint settlement.  Delays in project completion and refund demands are common complaint reasons.

news.title: Tamil Nadu RERA grants four-month extension to projects hit by West Asia disruption
news.para: Tamil Nadu RERA has extended the validity of registration and corresponding completion timelines of eligible registered real estate projects by four months. The relief applies to projects whose completion, revised completion or extended completion date falls on or after February 28, 2026.
